# 05. Terraform Infrastructure

## Terraform overview
This project uses Terraform as the infrastructure-as-code layer for AWS services.

## Core modules
- S3 bucket module
- IAM module
- Glue module
- Athena module
- Lake Formation module
- CloudWatch module
- QuickSight module

## Important notes
- No AWS resources are deployed yet.
- Terraform must be initialized and validated before use.
- A working AWS profile and regional configuration are required.
- QuickSight may require account-level activation.
